title: cobble and steel
description: Do you have the courage to build whatever your heart desires and destroy the world (hopefully not) in the process or are you going to stay in the stone age?
body:
This modpack is primarily based on Create: The factory must grow and Create: Aeronautics.
Build amazing diesel punk like vehicles or go into the future with Create: Propulsion!
Not enough energy? No problem. With Create: Nuclear you can have as much energy as you like.

Always frustrated with the limitations of mining and having to work(eeww) for basic resources? No problem, thanks to custom recipes almost everything can be automated.

But be careful: Thanks to Pollution of the reams there are consequences for expanding to recklessly.

Have fun!

PS: This mod is great for multiplayer thanks to Create: Numismatics.
